title: Zesty Flaky Mexican Poblano Tacos
description: A tangy and flaky Mexican dish featuring poblanos, strawberries, and a soffritto base, made with low-glycemic ingredients. This meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for 30 minutes.
Chop the roasted poblanos into small pieces.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, mix together the roasted poblanos, cooked onions and garlic, sliced strawberries, and lime juice.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Fry the almond flour taco shells in the coconut oil until they are crispy and golden brown.
Fill the taco shells with the poblano and strawberry mixture.
